Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: When opening the Wikipedia page for John de Vere, 16th Earl of Oxford, the WebSurfer surfaced the infobox line “Father: John de Vere, 14th Earl of Oxford,” which is incorrect and contradicts the article body (and reliable sources) stating his father was John de Vere, 15th Earl of Oxford. Relying on this would lead to the wrong paternal grandfather.
